answer_1.quote: Neural summarization systems aim to compress a document into a short paragraph or sentence while preserving key information... the focus of this work is on abstractive summarization.

answer_2.quote: We measure ROUGE scores and the recently proposed BERTScore when ground-truth is available.

answer_4.quote: For controlled summarization, we sample 100 examples for each task... we ask three our colleagues to evaluate through personal correspondence from the authors of this paper... we ask them to provide scores over two dimensions: (1) Control Accuracy (CA): whether the summary contains accurate main information of the intent, and (2) Control Relevance (CR): how the summary is relevant to the control intent overall.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators score summaries based on control intent using CA and CR dimensions.
